title: Church and State: three paths
goal: Read how Mexico, Ecuador and Colombia treated the power of the Church, and use impersonal se to say what was decided and what was possible.

items: Use impersonal *se* (*se decidió*, *se necesitaba*, *se podía*) to say what was decided and what was possible.
Say what changed in Mexico when the Church and the State were separated.
Say what the Ecuador constitution of 1869 required of citizens.
Say what Colombia did in 1886 and 1887.
Use the key words of this lesson: marriage, register, civil, religion, Catholic, concordat, secular and parish.
